note: v0.28.0：从「你打开才有内容」升级为「在对的时间提醒你练对的那句」（主动智能）。（1）出发前自动打包：在设置里填「去哪个城市 + 哪天到」，临近出发时首页直接给你一份 10 句的行程包，按到达、地铁、点餐、问路等场景跨区轮转抽取，每一句都来自你已经在学的城市句库——不新增一句要背的新内容；同时新上了北京、成都两座城市攻略，现在共 3 座城。（2）提醒分轻重，不打扰是最常见的结果：系统按四档判断该不该找你——① 行程临近（出发前一天和当天）② 连胜快断了（连了 3 天以上、又超过 20 小时没开口）③ 有到期该复习的句子 ④ 其余情况一律不提醒。第四档「其余不提醒」是刻意设计的：宁可少推，也不做打扰式召回。（3）点通知直达那一件事：通知点开就是行程包 / 场景扮演 / 到期复习，不用再自己找入口。（4）隐私与流量：提醒订阅只保存推送地址和一份最小画像（目标、城市、到达日期、连胜天数），不含任何聊天记录或录音；没有订阅的用户，App 不会发出任何相关请求。（5）顺带把离线缓存收紧了：带参数的页面地址不再重复占用缓存空间，接口数据不再落盘。
noteEn: v0.28.0: from 'content that waits for you to open it' to 'a nudge at the right moment to practise the right line' (proactive intelligence). (1) Automatic trip pack: set 'which city and which day you arrive' in Settings, and as the trip approaches Home hands you a 10-line trip pack drawn across arrival, metro, ordering food and asking for directions - every line comes from the city guide you are already studying, so there is nothing new to memorise; Beijing and Chengdu guides are new, bringing the total to three cities. (2) Nudges are graded, and staying silent is the usual outcome: the app decides in four tiers whether it is worth interrupting you - (a) the trip is imminent (the day before and the day of arrival), (b) your streak is about to break (three or more days, and nothing spoken for over 20 hours), (c) you have lines due for review, (d) anything else is left alone. That fourth tier, staying silent, is deliberate: we would rather under-notify than turn reminders into noise. (3) Tap through to the exact thing: the notification opens the trip pack, a scenario roleplay or the due review - no hunting for the entrance. (4) Privacy and traffic: a reminder subscription stores only the push endpoint and a minimal profile (goal, city, arrival date, streak), never any chat or recording; users who have not subscribed trigger no related request at all. (5) Offline caching was tightened along the way: page URLs carrying parameters no longer take up extra cache space, and API data is no longer written to disk.
